scope: Controlled COS SDK HTTP transport, real OpenSSL encryption and isolated native MySQL restore; synthetic records only. No live COS publication, permission changes or deployment.
covered: SDK requests signed for fixed COS host; versioning required before upload; exact returned version fully read and hashed before publication acknowledgement
Unversioned bucket, null version, mismatched version, corrupt/short/long response, redirect and lost PUT response produce no success receipt; uncertain PUT is not retried
Media keys, path traversal, oversized requests, incorrect digests and wrong target buckets rejected; partial downloads removed and existing files not overwritten
Snapshot and deletion checkpoint copied and authenticated, tar bundle encrypted using real OpenSSL, then retrieved to private fresh directory and independently verified
Publication receipt HMAC and pinned digest enforced; wrong scope, tampering, expired source snapshot, private-file violations and corrupted download fail closed

Real 36-table MySQL snapshot restored after controlled publish/fetch, with two deletion intents including one accepted after original snapshot; database remains quarantined and temporary services removed
development_failures: Go regexp rejected a repeat upper bound above 1000; replaced it with an explicit length check plus character validation.
Initial controlled upload fixture omitted COS CRC64 acknowledgement; corrected the provider fixture without disabling production SDK CRC verification.
limitations: 1 GiB encrypted bundle limit; larger bundles require multipart transport
Publication receipts currently local and must be independently retained; keys need independent escrow
No authoritative newest deletion checkpoint, post-snapshot provider-write reconciliation or live cutover
Remote retention/per-account historical backup erasure not implemented; uncertain uploads may leave unconfirmed objects
No real COS credentials/policy acceptance, Sandbox purchase/rebinding or device acceptance in this change
